import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def pow_mod(base, power, mod):
    return pow(base, power, mod)

def main():
    for line in sys.stdin:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        parts = line.split()
        if len(parts) < 2:
            continue
        p = int(parts[0])
        k = int(parts[1])
        if k == 0:
            print(pow_mod(p, p - 1, MOD))
            continue
        if k == 1:
            print(pow_mod(p, p, MOD))
            continue
        bs = [False] * p
        pow_count = 0
        for i in range(1, p):
            if bs[i]:
                continue
            j = i
            w = 0
            while not bs[j]:
                w += 1
                bs[j] = True
                j = (j * k) % p
            if pow_mod(k, w, p) == 1:
                pow_count += 1
        print(pow_mod(p, pow_count, MOD))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
